checkpoint: Starts where 19.02 ends: Route 23's south end (8, 153), VAR_MAP_SCENE_ROUTE23 at 1 (the Boulder Badge guard recognized). Each of the seven guards (Cascade to Earth) is a coord-event trigger, not a talk: stepping onto one of the live trigger tiles starts the scene, and with all eight badges it is one message and A; the next guard's triggers go live at the new value, the finished guards' stay quiet.

The stretch from (13, 118) to (x, 78) is water: the planner Surfs from the shore (HM03 Surf, taught in 12.01) and gets off on the north shore (rows 77 and up). The Soul and Marsh guards stand on its edge, with their triggers in the water, and are triggered while surfing.
Ends below Victory Road's mouth, Route 23 (5, 29), facing north; 19.04 teaches Strength and walks in.
